# Oryx Institute

> Oryx Institute is a multidisciplinary vocational education and training institution being established in Windhoek, Namibia.

## About

Oryx Institute is being developed to deliver practical, recognised skills through vocational education rooted in the Namibian landscape. The institution will train, assess, research, and advise across five planned schools.

## Status

Pre-launch. Applications are not yet open. No programme is confirmed or accredited.

## Schools

- School of Safety — Occupational safety, site inspection, fire safety, first aid, security practice
- School of Administration and Commerce — Office administration, bookkeeping, payroll, retail, commerce
- School of Hospitality and Tourism — Food and beverage service, front-of-house operations, housekeeping, tour guiding, visitor experience
- School of Information and Digital Skills — Digital literacy, computer hardware repair, workplace productivity, networking
- Future Schools — Placeholder for disciplines to be confirmed (construction, agriculture, creative industries possible)

## Programmes

Planned programmes across certificate, short course, and blended delivery. Full catalogue at /programmes.

## Pathways

- Classroom learning
- Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)
- Work-integrated learning (WIL)

## Brand

- Primary maroon: #7A0F1E
- Cream: #FFF8EF
- Ink: #171717
- Display typeface: Trajan Pro 3 (licensed) / Cinzel (fallback)
- Body typeface: Source Sans 3
- Voice: Quiet, restrained, honest. No superlatives, no puffery, no generated crowds.
